choice.basis: The chart displays a dual-axis line graph with the left y-axis labeled 'Agriculture (%)' and the right y-axis labeled 'Industry (%)'. The 2014 data points for both series do not have printed percentage labels. Furthermore, the vertical axes do not have visible numeric tick marks, making it impossible to determine if the scales are equivalent or to compare the absolute values of the two sectors. The visual position of the blue mark (higher) relative to the red mark (lower) cannot be used to determine which percentage is larger without knowing the scale of each axis. Therefore, the condition to identify the sector with the larger 2014 percentage cannot be met.
